scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
papers.authors: Taiga Ikeda, Daisuke Miyashita, Jun Deguchi
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13060v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3
papers.summary: KV-Repurpose 针对检索文档在不同提示位置出现时无法复用前缀缓存的问题，基于 vLLM 构建分段调度、缓存管理和监控测试平台。在仅20%请求共享固定前缀的负载下，同为30 GB缓存时命中率为63.9%，前缀缓存仅3.3%；前缀缓存扩至1 TB仍仅17.9%。单文档任务质量较稳定，跨文档推理仍有明显限制。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索引入LLM摘要或问答后，相同UGC内容可能出现在不同历史上下文中，分段缓存比增加前缀缓存容量更值得验证。平台将调度、容量和工作负载放在一起测量，可借鉴其测试方法评估首字延迟与命中率。跨文档推理存在质量损失，应先在单帖摘要上试点，并用nDCG与回答质量回归约束缓存复用。

papers.title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
papers.abstract: NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to...
papers.summary: NVIDIA将完整Run:ai平台开源，提供KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management及Workload Map四个可独立采用的组件。平台覆盖GPU感知调度、CUDA原生显存分片、组织配额和工作负载管理，8家DSX生态伙伴宣布集成。文章提供源码与Helm部署入口，但未给出统一吞吐提升基准。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的离线特征加工、embedding 生成和在线推理可共享GPU池；按组件引入公平调度及硬显存边界，比一次替换整个平台更容易试点。CUDA 13.4原生分片和配额管理有助于控制小模型之间的资源竞争，但显存隔离不等于延迟隔离。应以在线尾延迟和离线完成时间验证收益，文中的4组件、8伙伴属于发布事实而非性能证据。
papers.evidence_note: 发布与工程集成事实；未披露量化性能基准。

papers.title: PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling
papers.authors: Nan Jiang, Panagiotis Theodoropoulos, Wei Deng
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13171v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next proposal is generated. Prior work reduces this cost by changing the sampler or the model (e.g., sequential Monte Carlo, approximate lookahead, distillation). We propose Predictive SubTree Prefetching (PreSTO), which accelerates PowerMH by prefetching future proposals and provably leaves its MH transition kernel unchanged. PreSTO views future MH outcomes as a tree of accept/reject decisions: in each model call, it generates the proposals of a \textit{prefetched subtree} of this tree in one batch, then follows the realized path with the original MH acceptance rule. We also observe that MH reaches only a sparse, nearly unary part of each prefetch
papers.summary: PreSTO 用预测子树预取加速串行的Metropolis–Hastings幂采样：一次批处理生成多个未来接受或拒绝路径的提案，再沿实际路径执行原接受规则，保持转移核不变。在7个数据集、5个模型上，三类采样器的中位加速为1.71、1.91和2.33倍；前两类模型调用减少3.9倍，单次调用耗时增加2.1倍。
papers.key_insight: 创新在于把未来采样路径变成可批量计算的子树，而无需蒸馏新模型或改变采样分布。社区搜索中的复杂离线query分析若使用幂采样，可借鉴其批量预取与路径预测设计；普通在线排序并不会自动受益。实践应同时测量批量显存、总模型调用和尾延迟，避免把推理加速直接等同于nDCG或CTR提升。

papers.title: Host-Aware Web Crawling for LLM Pretraining Data
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13321v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Web crawling is a major source of large language model (LLM) pretraining data, yet data-selection pipelines discard a large share of crawled pages. We investigate how a crawler should allocate its budget across and within hosts to collect more high-quality pretraining data. Combining document-level quality classifier scores, web-graph centrality metrics, and Common Crawl's per-host crawl coverage, we find that roughly half of the variation in classifier scores occurs between hosts. In the crawls we analyze, a few pages from a host also provide a useful estimate of the quality of its remaining pages. Common Crawl uses harmonic centrality, a graph centrality metric, to guide its crawl allocation. In our simulations, using centrality to choose which hosts to crawl yields limited gains over random ordering and performs worse for some classifiers. For deciding how deeply to crawl each host, sampling a few pages and then fetching more from hos
papers.summary: 论文研究如何把预训练爬虫预算分配到不同站点及站内页面。分析发现，约一半文档质量分数差异来自站点之间；少量页面即可估计同站后续内容质量。先抽样、再增加高质量站点抓取深度，比均匀深度或中心性分配每次抓取获得数倍高质量页面，并估计各次爬取仍遗漏数千万优质页面。
papers.key_insight: 可迁移的设计是让数据质量反馈进入抓取调度，而非先大量下载再过滤。社区UGC搜索建立训练语料或外部知识补充时，可按来源抽样质量，再调整抓取预算，同时保留长尾来源以避免同质化。论文证据来自爬取模拟，尚未证明搜索nDCG或CTR收益；上线前需单独评估覆盖度、重复率和实际请求成本。

papers.title: Overcoming Data Imbalances with Expert Selection Biases
papers.authors: Ayush K. Tarun, Clara Meister, Antoine Bosselut
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13370v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the standard architecture for frontier LLMs. The multiple parallel experts in each transformer block theoretically enable expert specialization according to categories such as domains, languages, or modalities during pretraining. However, when data is imbalanced across categories, minority categories can become concentrated in a small fraction of the expert pool or spread inefficiently across them, effectively limiting their available capacity. In this work, we demonstrate that category-conditioned expert-selection biases can preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools. By applying biases based on input category, we provide a simple way to induce soft category-aligned specialization. This intervention encourages categories toward distinct expert subsets while retaining cross-category sharing when useful. More importantly, it enables the over-allocation
papers.summary: 作者为MoE路由加入按领域、语言或模态条件化的专家选择偏置，使少数类别拥有更适当的专家容量，并保持跨类别共享。模型规模最高10.6B，低资源语言、代码和模态任务均出现收益；最小与最大规模的收益分别相当于基线额外使用18.5%和2.7%的训练token。方法保留标准MoE推理路径。
papers.key_insight: 专家数量充足并不意味着少数类别能有效使用容量，显式路由偏置提供了可控的训练侧资源分配手段。社区搜索若训练多领域query模型，可参考它照顾小众话题与低频语言，但需要可靠类别标签及MoE训练基础。应检查全局相关性与各类别nDCG，防止平均分提升掩盖热门类别退化；本文没有社区搜索线上CTR证据。

papers.title: Scale Bitwise-Deterministic Pretraining with NVIDIA Megatron Core
papers.abstract: Scale Bitwise-Deterministic Pretraining with NVIDIA Megatron Core
papers.summary: Megatron Core以逐rank张量指纹和分层追踪定位非确定性，将输入相同、输出不同的首个操作作为排查起点。通过缓冲区优化、固定归约顺序和保持并行的内核改造，大规模Nemotron训练在2432张GPU上确定性开销约2%，连续800步逐位一致；另一3072 GPU配置开销约1.5%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索模型训练常需区分数据变化、模型改动与系统噪声，这套从端到端指标收缩到内核的排查方法可直接参考。验证应同时覆盖独立重跑和断点恢复，指纹相同后仍需逐字节确认；低精度缩放元数据也应保存。确定性保证限定同硬件软件环境，2%开销来自特定大规模配方，不能直接当作现有排序训练平台的成本估计。

papers.title: From 2.1M Hours of Raw Broadcast Audio to Finnish Speech SSL: Confidence Filtering and Architectural Analysis at Scale
papers.authors: Yaroslav Getman, Tam\'as Gr\'osz, Tommi Lehtonen, Mikko Kurimo
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13102v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Broadcast archives offer scale and diversity for self-supervised learning (SSL) but contain substantial noisy, non-speech, and multilingual content. Prior work typically relies on voice activity detection or language identification (LID) to extract speech, ensuring presence rather than quality. Whether and how to filter unlabeled speech by quality for SSL, particularly from noisy broadcasts, remains underexplored. We present a large-scale Finnish SSL study starting from 2.1M hours of unconstrained broadcast audio. We propose automatic speech recognition (ASR) confidence as a proxy for pretraining data quality and show 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering despite a smaller training set. We further address the lack of controlled architectural comparisons in speech SSL by evaluating Transformer, Macaron-Net, Conformer, and E-Branchformer at matched parameter budgets. Our models improve upon prior Finnish SSL baselines, pa
papers.summary: 研究从210万小时原始广播音频构建芬兰语自监督预训练数据，使用ASR置信度筛选质量，而非仅依赖语音活动或语言识别。即使保留较少训练数据，相比LID过滤仍取得3%至7%的相对词错误率下降；并在匹配参数预算下比较Transformer、Macaron-Net、Conformer和E-Branchformer四种架构。
papers.key_insight: 该工作属于语音模型训练与数据基础设施，与当前UGC短文本搜索只有间接关联，因此商业相关分较低。值得借鉴的是按下游代理质量筛数据，并在相同参数预算下比较架构；它提示更多原始数据不一定更有效。若后续加入语音query，可先验证ASR置信度与本地口语识别质量的关系，不能把芬兰语WER收益视为中文搜索收益。

papers.title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13134v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language. The pipeline comprises RoSfera, a 635 GB Romanian corpus containing 175.7 million documents; an 80k byte-level BPE tokenizer; five decoder-only models ranging from 160M to 6B parameters, trained on 131 billion tokens; three instruction-tuned assistants; and two contrastively trained embedding models. Training and evaluation were conducted using computing infrastructure at ELI-NP/IFIN-HH.
  The model family exhibits consistent scaling of validation loss and increasing Romanian factual and cultural knowledge with model size. On the 1,000-question WWTBM benchmark, Neurograf-6B achieves 69.89% accuracy on Romanian-context questions, while Neurograf-3.2B reaches 67.38%. Compute-optimal analysis yields a parameter-scaling exponent of
papers.summary: Neurograf v1 从语料、分词到模型构建罗马尼亚语优先的完整训练流水线：635 GB语料含1.757亿文档，80k词表，5个160M至6B模型共使用1310亿token，并提供3个助手和2个 embedding 模型。1000题WWTBM中，6B与3.2B在罗马尼亚语语境问题上的准确率分别为69.89%与67.38%。
papers.key_insight: 统一建设语料、分词器、基础模型与 embedding 模型，能暴露低资源语言在变音符号、数据组成和token效率上的系统问题。对中文社区搜索更有价值的是流水线与数据质量经验，罗马尼亚语指标不能直接迁移。该系列是实验演示而非生产系统；可先对社区口语和长尾词做分词、召回回归，再判断从头训练是否值得投入。

papers.title: Time Delay System for Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.12864v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Existing sequence models share a critical limitation: they lack an explicit, interpretable mechanism for content-aware temporal recall. LSTMs compress everything into a single hidden state, thereby losing information about specific past events. Transformers attend to all tokens indiscriminately at quadratic cost, while state-space models like Mamba compress history into a fixed-dimensional state without explicit content-addressable memory. To address this gap, we introduce a novel framework grounded in nonlinear time-delay systems, in which the effective delay is dynamically estimated based on the semantic similarity between current and historical inputs. Our approach features three key innovations: (i) a differentiable semantic lag estimator that computes content-aware soft attention weights over history, producing a weighted historical context and similarity score; (ii) a diagonal state space with closed-form cumulative sum solution, a
papers.summary: 论文将可微语义时滞估计、对角状态空间累计求解和模糊规则调节组合成TDS序列架构，显式控制当前输入与历史信息的融合。作者报告IMDB上2.6M参数模型准确率95.35%、训练2100秒；CNN/DailyMail上16.98M参数模型ROUGE-L为42.63。比较表部分基线来自其他文献，统一实验可比性有限。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴的是将历史召回位置与融合规则显式建模，而非仅依赖固定状态压缩。社区短文本query理解可用小模型做受控原型，但这篇工作缺少大规模部署与搜索相关性证据，作者也承认基准数量少且超参数敏感。复现时应统一数据切分、训练预算与基线实现，实际测量吞吐和nDCG，谨慎解释常数每步复杂度的适用边界。
papers.evidence_note: 基线来自不同文献，比较条件未统一；降低证据质量分。
